About

Profile

I am an Electronic and Computer Engineer with a Distinction-level academic record, recognised with top-performance awards in 2024 and 2025.

My work sits where hardware meets software: training vision models, driving robotic arms over WiFi, and designing the boards and circuits underneath. I like projects I can build, test on a bench and show working.

I am a member of TTI Innovators DUT and the Thensa Entrepreneurial Program 2026, and I speak English and isiZulu.
